title: Tri-zone GPU demand & rollout scenario planner (24mo)
summary: Two-year, month-by-month planner comparing baseline (P50) demand, P90 surge scenarios, and activation windows across North America (NA), Europe (EU), and APAC. Designed to support tactical procurement/spot reservations and phased cloud-zone activations with explicit buffer targets and target utilization goals by workload mix.

notes: Model assumptions: 1) baseline P50 derived from product telemetry growth + expected new enterprise deals; 2) P90 = P50 * 1.5 unless region-specific adjustments apply; 3) Target utilization aims to balance unit cost vs. latency SLOs (70-79% typical); 4) Buffer is the % of spare GPUs to keep cold/warm for rapid activation; 5) GPU type mix evolves: A100 remains bulk for general workloads, H100 reserved for throughput/LLM-heavy customers. Sensitivity: +10% monthly growth pushes NA into elastic H100 reservations earlier.
